name: NMS Global Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1986, NMS Resources Global 
Ltd is in the business of Trading & Consultancy Services.
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
Company was into food processing and commodity supply sector and is currently engaged in contracting services like Civil Construction, Pre-Engineered Buildings, Skill Development, Financial Consultancy and Engineering Services. Company also provides exclusive supplies and marketing team for telecom provider companies.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 25.7%
cons: Stock is trading at 14.0 times its book value
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.61 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 184 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -11.4%
Working capital days have increased from 8.13 days to 84.0 days
